newsitem.title: GERMANY: One killed, 20 injured in German train crash.
newsitem.headline: One killed, 20 injured in German train crash.

text.p: A German rail engineer was killed and 20 people injured when a passenger train crashed into a parked freight train in the western city of Essen, police said on Tuesday.
The engineer of the passenger train travelling from Muenster to Essen was crushed to death in the accident, which happened near a north Essen freight train station.
Police said most of the injuries were not serious. They said after a preliminary investigation that human error was believed to be responsible for the crash.
